title: Output of a randomized machine attempt
statement: Let $N$ assign a finite nondeterministic Turing machine to each bit, let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $b$ be a Boolean choice, and let $u$ be a finite word of Boolean choices. The output produced by the randomized attempt on input $x$ with choice word $b::u$ equals the output of machine $N(b)$ on $x$ with choice word $u$, after retaining each true output symbol and replacing it by $b$, and discarding each false output symbol.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-indexed family of finite nondeterministic Turing machines
